articles.headline: Swift launches blockchain shared ledger with 16 banks
articles.summary: Swift’s new blockchain-based shared ledger could reshape cross-border payments by enabling round-the-clock settlement and competing more directly with stablecoin rails. For banks and corporates, this may lower friction in international treasury operations and influence future payment infrastructure decisions.

articles.headline: Amazon shares surge on AI progress and accelerating AWS growth
articles.summary: Amazon’s strong cloud growth and bigger AI spending plans signal continued demand for enterprise cloud and AI infrastructure. That matters for businesses because it reinforces the likelihood of rising AI-related capacity investment, vendor competition, and longer-term cloud platform shifts.

articles.headline: Samsung says chip shortage could extend to 2028
articles.summary: Samsung’s warning that the chip shortage may last until 2028 matters for companies that depend on memory and other semiconductors for devices, servers, and AI infrastructure. A prolonged shortage can keep input costs high, delay hardware deployments, and force procurement teams to revise supply plans.
